responsibility: Manages register elimination within LRA, especially replacing eliminable hard registers such as frame or argument pointers with their current base registers plus dynamically changing offsets. It maintains the elimination table and current elimination map, decides when an elimination becomes impossible, updates offset-dependent RTL before constraint passes, spills pseudos that rely on now-uneliminable registers, and performs the final hard-register substitution at the end of LRA. This file owns elimination offset tracking and elimination-driven RTL rescanning.
